headlines.title: Trump unveils 'Super Intelligence Force' to oversee AI policy
headlines.description: The president named his national intelligence chief as the taskforce's head as worries over AI grow.

headlines.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
headlines.description: The co-ordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

headlines.title: UK diesel prices top £2 a litre for first time, RAC says
headlines.description: The rise in global oil prices has been pushing up the pump prices of petrol and diesel in the UK.

headlines.title: US pressures Europe to release diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has threatened to ban diesel exports in a bid to ease prices in the US ahead of the November elections.

headlines.title: AI boom could trigger market shocks, Bank of England boss warns
headlines.description: Andrew Bailey says the central bank is watching the waves of cash being invested in artificial intelligence "very carefully".
